question: persister
prompt:
Research question: "What measurements or analyses would best reveal why a small fraction of genetically identical cancer cells survive targeted drug treatment?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Single-cell lineage barcoding with drug-response tracking
ideas.description: Label a clonal cancer population with heritable DNA barcodes (e.g., CRISPR-based lineage tracers), treat with the targeted drug, and track which lineages persist and how their transcriptomes and chromatin states differ before treatment. This separates pre-existing 'drug-tolerant' clones from cells that switch state after exposure.

ideas.title: Pre-treatment single-cell multi-omics to find predictive baseline states
ideas.description: Profile untreated cells with paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq (or CITE-seq) and use machine learning to identify baseline features, such as expression of stress, quiescence, or drug-efflux genes, that predict which cells will survive. Validate by sorting the predicted tolerant subpopulation and testing its drug response.

ideas.title: Live-cell imaging with reporter-based fate tracking
ideas.description: Use fluorescent reporters for cell cycle (e.g., FUCCI), signaling activity (e.g., ERK or AKT biosensors), and drug-target engagement, and follow individual cells over days of treatment. This reveals whether survivors were in a slow-cycling or signaling-low state before drug exposure, or whether they adapt over time.

ideas.title: Time-resolved persister-state transitions with pulse-chase drug exposure
ideas.description: Expose cells to the drug for short pulses, then wash out and sort survivors at multiple timepoints for bulk or single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq. This distinguishes stable genetic or epigenetic persistence from transient, reversible drug-tolerant states that re-enter the cycle after drug withdrawal.

ideas.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screens for survival and resistance mechanisms
ideas.description: Run pooled CRISPR knockout or CRISPRi/a screens under sublethal drug doses, comparing sequencing of survivors versus the starting population to identify genes that enable survival without acquired mutations. Follow up hits with combination-drug tests to determine whether the survival machinery is a druggable vulnerability.
